g.text: - Each running process has no knowledge of any other process. They don't see the "big picture" of what's running on the machine.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Their only way to interact with the outside world is by making requests to the operating system.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - A running process is like an apartment in a building, where the occupants have no idea that the building itself even exists - they

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: only ever see the room that they live in.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: - This prevents processes from "out of bounds" reads and writes; from touching data that does not belong to them.
